scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('npm install --include=dev', { cwd: './backend', stdio: 'inherit' }); execSync('npm install --include=dev', { cwd: './frontend', stdio: 'inherit' });"
